generation_contract.positive_template: One {body_color} {material} {form_factor} {object_type}, a household {category}. Its front face has exactly two unmistakable functional regions: horizontal speaker-grille slats spanning the lower front, and one small circular translucent momentary push button on the upper front glowing amber or blue. The illuminated button is flush-mounted and visibly luminous, never a knob or dial. The side panels are plain with no controls.
generation_contract.pose_guard_prompt: Render exactly one object, centered, resting stably on a flat neutral surface against a plain seamless light-gray background. Three-quarter product view from slightly above eye level so the front and one side are both visible. The entire object fits in frame with a clear margin on every side. Physically plausible real-world proportions and construction. Even studio lighting, soft shadow directly beneath the object only. No humans, no hands, no text, no logos, no labels, no screens showing content, no cables trailing out of frame, no reflections of surroundings, no additional objects, no cropping. This is a neutral reconstruction reference for image-to-3D, not an advertisement scene.
generation_contract.negative_prompt: human, hand, fingers, text, logo, watermark, label, sticker, multiple objects, duplicated object, cropped object, cut off, close-up detail shot, extreme perspective, fisheye, tilted camera, floating object, reflection of photographer, cluttered background, background furniture, scene environment, packaging box, advertisement layout, collage, split image, featureless box, blank front panel, plain cover without grille, missing front button, unlit button, side button, side control, rotary knob, rotary dial, large round knob, volume dial
